title: Pay $0.01 USDC to create a leaderboard or add, update, or delete one entry. Use
description: Pay $0.01 USDC to create a leaderboard or add, update, or delete one entry. Use a secret leaderboard_key UUID to continue writing to the same board. If value is null, the named entry is deleted. Public pages stay free at GET /leaderboard/{slug}. Network: Base Mainnet. Each request writes one named score and returns the board key and URLs.
